/narrative.1: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to reducing rural poverty and stimulating economic growth in the regions of Tonpki, Kabadougou, Folon, Bafing, Worodougou and Béré. The development objective is to sustainably improve food security by increasing smallholder access to effective services, appropriate technology and markets while increasing the resilience of production systems to climate change.
